instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Management consulting firm serving mid-market companies with strategy, operational excellence, and digital transformation engagements. Team of 40 consultants across 3 offices. Typical engagements are 8-16 weeks. Evaluating knowledge management AI to capture and surface past engagement insights for proposal development. The company has mature core business processes but struggles with the tension between running the existing operation efficiently and carving out resources for innovation.
answers.pastInitiatives: We launched a digital customer onboarding flow last quarter that reduced average onboarding time from 12 days to 5 days. The project was cross-functional involving product, compliance, and customer success teams. Early NPS scores for new customers onboarded through this flow are 22 points higher than the legacy process.
answers.strategicGoals: Our board has set an ambitious revenue target of reaching €50M ARR within 5 years from our current base. This requires us to expand our addressable market, potentially pivot pricing models from one-time to recurring revenue, and build a repeatable enterprise sales motion. We need to identify the highest-leverage growth levers without overextending our cash runway.
answers.additionalContext: Synapse Services currently relies heavily on manual data aggregation across engagements, creating a bottleneck for rapid insight generation. While internal teams have adopted specialized tools, the integration between these digital pockets and core operations remains fragmented.
answers.teamSize: The technology organization is structured into product-aligned squads with a central platform team of 5 engineers enabling shared infrastructure. Innovation is driven by a '20% time' policy where all engineers can dedicate one day per sprint to self-directed projects, plus a quarterly internal pitch competition where winning ideas receive seed funding and 3 months of dedicated squad allocation.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Knowledge Management Optimization
opportunities.rationale: Implementing a sophisticated AI layer over existing knowledge management tools can automate the research and drafting of proposals, significantly reducing consultant time spent on administrative tasks. This leverages current digital maturity to improve operational efficiency without requiring massive platform overhauls.

first_actions: Select and integrate a mid-market AI language model tailored for proposal generation.
Identify three high-volume engagement types for pilot testing the system.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in average proposal drafting time by 30% within Q2
milestones: Q1: Vendor selection and proof-of-concept completion.
Q2: Pilot rollout to two consulting teams.

opportunities.title: Consulting-as-a-Service (CaaS) Platform Development
opportunities.rationale: To achieve aggressive growth and recurring revenue goals, Synapse should pivot toward productizing core consulting methodologies into subscription platforms. This radical shift moves the company from selling time/projects to selling scalable intellectual property, dramatically increasing margin potential.

first_actions: Establish a dedicated 'Productization' task force (2 people).
Conduct market validation interviews with 10 target mid-market clients regarding recurring service needs.
resources_needed: Seed funding allocation from the formal committee ($50k)
Hiring a dedicated Product Owner/Strategist (talent focus)
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 15% of total revenue from subscription models within 2 years
milestones: Q3: Minimum Viable Service Package defined and priced.
Q4: Launch pilot program with recurring revenue structure.

next_steps.action: Form a cross-functional task force to prioritize and define the roadmap for internal knowledge monetization.
Conduct feasibility study and budget modeling for the Consulting-as-a-Service (CaaS) pivot, securing initial seed funding approval.

key_weaknesses: Significant gap between mature core processes and fragmented digital maturity across the organization.
Internal tension between maintaining operational efficiency (cost control) and allocating resources for high-risk innovation.
Reliance on manual workflows and disparate spreadsheets hinders scalable data utilization required for modern consulting services.
